description: Samoca于1957年推出的旁轴相机。配备D Ezumar 1:2,8/50mm。快门速度Samoca Synchro leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec. and B. Sometimes also a Selftimer.。使用35mm。

specs.快门: Samoca Synchro leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec. and B. Sometimes also a Selftimer.
specs.闪光灯: M till 1/25 sec. speed. X till 1/300 sec. speed. Flash connector socket on shutter.
specs.取景器: optical finder with superimposed coupled rangefinder, bright frame with parallax correction marks
specs.英文简介: The Samoca 35 LE is a viewfinder camera for 35mm film with a built-in light meter, made in Japan by Sanei Sangyō K.K.
